يتعاهدون (form VI)
# يَتَعَاهَدُونَ (yataʕāhadūna) /ja.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
# يُتَعَاهَدُونَ (yutaʕāhadūna) /ju.ta.ʕaː.ha.duː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَاهَدَ (taʕāhada)
